title: Ubud vs Canggu: Which Should You Visit?
description: A data-backed comparison of Ubud and Canggu based on Reddit discussions, real costs, and traveler preferences.

categories.title: 💰 Cost Comparison
categories.summary: Ubud is meaningfully cheaper than Canggu, particularly for accommodation and local food. The key driver is Canggu's premium on the "lifestyle" — the café-brunch-beach-club scene inflates daily spending. In Ubud, you can have an outstanding day for $30–40; in Canggu, the same lifestyle costs $60–80.

categories.title: ☀️ Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: Ubud and Canggu share Bali's tropical climate but feel noticeably different due to elevation. Ubud sits at ~200m above sea level, making it 2–4°C cooler than Canggu on average — a meaningful difference during hot months. Both areas experience Bali's wet and dry seasons.

faqs.question: Should I stay in Ubud or Canggu for my first trip to Bali?
faqs.answer: If this is your first Bali trip and you want the authentic, iconic experience — rice terraces, temples, monkey forest, spiritual vibes — start with Ubud. If you want beaches, surf, trendy cafés, and nightlife, Canggu is your spot. Most visitors do both: 3–4 nights in Ubud, then 3–4 nights in Canggu.

faqs.question: Is Ubud or Canggu cheaper?
faqs.answer: Ubud is generally cheaper for accommodation — jungle villas and boutique guesthouses run $25–70/night, and local warung meals cost IDR 20,000–40,000 ($1.25–$2.50). faqs.answer: Canggu wins for digital nomads overall — it has better coworking spaces (Dojo Canggu, BWork, Outpost), the best café density for working with laptops, stronger WiFi infrastructure, and the largest nomad community. faqs.answer: Ubud to Canggu is roughly 35–40km by road, but Bali traffic makes it a 1.5–2.5 hour journey depending on time of day. Morning (before 10am) or evening (after 7pm) trips are faster. faqs.question: Does Ubud have beaches?
faqs.answer: No — Ubud is inland, roughly 25km from the nearest beach. It's in the highlands at about 200m elevation, surrounded by rice terraces and jungle. faqs.answer: Ubud is the best base for Bali day trips.
